p: Judah: Though Judah was not Jacob's eldest son, yet he first begins with him, because he would come to the genealogy of David, of whom came Christ.
Ram: Whom Matthew calls Aram, Mt 1:3.
prince of the children of Judah: That is, chief of the family.
Caleb the son of Hezron begat: Who was called Chelubai the son of Hezron, 1Ch 2:9.
Gilead: Who was prince of mount Gilead, Nu 32:40.
from them: That is, the Geshurites and Syrians took the towns from Jair's children.
Calebephratah: Which was a town named for the husband and wife, also called Bethlehem Ephratah.
father of Tekoa: Meaning, the chief and prince.
Ahlai: Who died while his father was alive, and therefore it is said in 1Ch 2:34 that Sheshan had no sons.
father of Ziph: That is, the chief governor or prince of the Ziphims, because the prince should have a fatherly care and affection for his people.

concubine: The difference between the wife and the concubine was that the wife was taken with a ceremony of marriage and her children inherited, while the concubine had no marriage ceremony, neither did her children inherit, but had a portion of goods or money given to them.
house of Joab: The chief and principle of the house of Joab.
scribes which dwelt at Jabez: Who were men learned and expert in the law.
Kenites that came of Hemath: Read Nu 10:29, Jud 1:16.
